{"consolidated_memory":"## Broken Layout in Email Renderer: Multiple Occasions in notifications/email/render.py

**Common characteristics across all occasions:**
- Component: notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)
- Symptom: broken layout in the email renderer, specifically a table that overflows in the plain text part
- Reproduction: render the digest template with a long subject
- Stack: Python
- Covering test: tests/notifications/test_render.py

**Occasion 1 - [2026-01-06] - Floating Point Rounding Issue (PR #1360, branch fix/broken-layout-1)**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- Result: p99 latency fell from 1.8 s to 678 ms

**Occasion 2 - [2026-02-03] - Unbounded Retry Loop (PR #1875, branch fix/broken-layout-2)**
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- Result: flaky test went from 17 failures per hundred runs to zero

**Occasion 3 - [2026-03-15] - Transaction Integrity Issue (PR #2332, branch fix/broken-layout-4)**
- Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- Result: throughput rose 18 percent to 912 requests per second

**Occasion 4 - [2026-03-19] - Schema Drift Issue (PR #2503, branch fix/broken-layout-5)**
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- Result: cold start dropped 54 percent to 177 ms

**Occasion 5 - [2026-08-21] - Timezone Awareness Issue (PR #9800, branch fix/broken-layout-8)**
- Trigger: when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- Result: error rate dropped from 1.3 percent to under 6 per ten thousand"}
